PLUGIN_DESCRIPTION: Provides org validation/repair and advanced operations (move/merge/reorder).
PERM_VALIDATE_DESC: Allow validating department tree integrity and primary department rules.
PERM_REPAIR_DESC: Allow repairing directory fields and primary departments.
PERM_MOVE_DESC: Allow moving departments within the tree.
PERM_REORDER_DESC: Allow reordering departments under the same parent.
